agent.description: SharePoint access via Microsoft Graph for the Mail/Capture agent — discover sites, browse document libraries and folders, open/download a specific file BY ID, and read list data to ground outreach and proposals in the company's real material. Pair with the `search_sharepoint` graph tool: search FINDS the file and returns its drive_id + item id; pass those to GET_DRIVE_ITEM / DOWNLOAD_DRIVE_ITEM to OPEN/read it.
